edges.reason: msg.sender is used as caller for allowance checks and balance updates in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key when setting allowances in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner to set sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balance.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor uses msg.sender to set owner and initial balance.
owner state variable is assigned from msg.sender in constructor.
msg.sender can be the _from argument passed to ensure.
transfer calls transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
transferFrom calls ensure to validate the transfer.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries with unchecked arithmetic.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
setTradeAddress assigns tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner.
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] to totalSupply.
constructor sets allowance for the Uniswap router.
constructor sets totalSupply.
constructor sets name.
constructor sets symbol.
ensure reads owner for the whitelist comparison.
ensure reads tradeAddress for the whitelist comparison.
ensure reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist comparison.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI address.
condition reads _saleNum.
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom performs unchecked balance arithmetic, creating an arithmetic weakness.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and balance arithmetic.
ensure whitelist short-circuit returns true bypassing condition and balance checks.
delegate executes an owner-controlled delegatecall to arbitrary code.
delegate performs an external delegatecall that can re-enter the contract.
The unchecked arithmetic operation in transferFrom directly writes balanceOf.
The unchecked arithmetic operation in batchSend directly writes balanceOf.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom balance and allowance logic.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom balance updates.
_value parameter flows into transferFrom amount checks and balance updates.
total local variable flows into batchSend balance subtraction and loop bounds.
_tos parameter flows into the batchSend distribution loop.
addr parameter is assigned to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress.
Parameter a flows into the delegatecall target in delegate.
Parameter b flows into the delegatecall data in delegate.
